Name: Recurring Payment Framework
Author: CozyPsychologist
Description:
[center][b][u][size=4]Recurring Payments Framework[/size][/u][/b][/center]


[size=4]A lightweight Stardew Valley 1.6 framework for creating recurring payments through JSON.

Mod authors can use it to add:

- memberships
- subscriptions
- taxes
- rent
- service fees
- recurring dues
- seasonal payments
- mail-based renewal offers

[b][u]Features[/u][/b]
 
- JSON-based content packs
- Daily, seasonal, and specific-day billing
- Yes/No payment prompts
- Mail-based subscription offers
- Automatic payments
- Active/inactive subscription states
- Reoffers after insufficient funds or declined payments
- Game State Query support
- Content Patcher token support
- Public C# API
- Per-player save data
- Multiplayer support
- Developer/debug console commands
- Android-friendly mail handling[/size]

[size=4][b][u]Example[/u][/b]
 
{
  "Id": "YourName.MyMod.Membership",
  "Name": "Guild Membership",
  "Cost": 2500,
 
  "Schedule": {
    "Type": "SeasonStart"
  },
 
  "Duration": {
    "Type": "Season"
  },
 
  "Prompt": {
    "Method": "Mail",
    "MailId": "YourName.MyMod.Renewal",
    "MailTitle": "Membership Renewal",
    "MailText": "Your seasonal membership is ready to renew.",
    "Text": "Renew your membership for {cost}g?",
    "YesText": "Renew",
    "NoText": "Not now"
  },
 
  "Reoffer": {
    "Enabled": true,
    "EveryDays": 3,
    "OnInsufficientFunds": true,
    "OnDecline": false
  }
}[/size]
    
[size=4]The framework handles the rest. [/size]

[size=4][b][u]Requirements[/u][/b]
 
- Stardew Valley 1.6
- SMAPI
 
Content Patcher is optional and only needed if your mod uses the framework's CP tokens.[/size]

[size=4][b][u]For Mod Authors[/u][/b]
 
A Mod Author Guide, API reference, example content pack, and JSON schema are included to help you get started.
 
This framework is intended to be used as a dependency for other mods. Players generally only need to install it when another mod requires it.[/size]

[size=4]This mod does nothing on its own. [/size]

[b][u][size=4]Reporting Bugs[/size][/u][/b]
[b]If you are reporting a bug it is paramount that you include your SMAPI log. I literally cannot help fix the problem without it. [/b]
